verdict.rationale: First-party material says Claude Code "maps and explains entire codebases in a few seconds." It uses agentic search to understand project structure and dependencies without manual context selection, and it can explain complex code. Together these clearly deliver the core of understanding how a codebase fits together. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the exploration workflow, explicit evidence of pinpointing where to start making changes, independent or hands-on corroboration of codebase-mapping quality.
